T3 - Operations: a strong considered as a human operation/movement, not tied to one inner-being cluster; context may pair the operation with a specific cluster.

T4 - Adversarial: a strong referring to the adversarial spiritual party (Satan/the Devil) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; a code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one. First of the emerging finer-grained buckets refining T2/T3, per researcher instruction 2026-09-05.

T5 - Negator: a strong expressing grammatical negation (not/no) -- one relation shared by every member, directly supporting verse_lexical.is_negator/polarity reading. Referent/function classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis.

T6 - Connective: a strong functioning as a clause-linking word (causal/coordinating/purpose) -- kept as one bucket per the researcher's own granularity test (2026-09-05): the finer causal/coordinating/purpose distinction is real but too small a grouping (1-3 codes each) to earn its own top-level cluster code; it is recorded in each row's own rationale instead. Referent/function classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis.

T7 - Party-Divine: a strong referring to the divine party (God/the LORD/Christ) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; directly supports observation-catalogue party-kind questions (a different T-numbering scheme, see the glossary's own T1 disambiguation entry). A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one.

T8 - Party-Human: a strong referring to a human party (man/woman/mankind/human) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; directly supports observation-catalogue party-kind questions. A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one.

T9 - Party-Angelic: a strong referring to an angelic party (messenger/angel) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; distinguished from T4/Adversarial per the observation catalogue's own T4.6.1/T4.6.2 split (angelic vs adversarial genuinely need telling apart). A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one.

T10 - Places: a strong referring to a location/realm (heaven, earth, Sheol/Hades, death as a state/realm, wilderness, mountain, desert, valley, abyss, etc.) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; distinguished from T2/Supplementary by being a genuine analytic candidate (movement source/destination), not excluded. A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one. Created 2026-09-08, escalation #1598, researcher-approved.

T11 - Corporate/Collective: a strong referring to a nation, people, tribe, or city as an acting corporate unit (Israel, Judah, Jerusalem, Egypt, Assyria, Moab, Babylon, Gentiles, generic 'people'/'city'/'tribe') -- distinct from T8/Party-Human's individual-human grain; referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis. A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one. Created 2026-09-08, escalation #1598, researcher-approved.

T12 - Objects/Artifacts: a strong referring to a man-made object recurring as a characteristic's target (idol, gold, silver, sword, weapon, altar) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; distinct from T10/Places (not a location) and T3/Operations (not a verb). A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one. Created 2026-09-08, escalation #1598, researcher-approved.

T13 - Natural World: a strong referring to a natural phenomenon, element, or creature (water, fire, storm, animal, plant) that can be the endpoint of a characteristic's movement (e.g. fear of a storm, trust in water) -- named by the researcher early in this escalation (section 3c) but not built until now, when real candidates surfaced in the T2 noun-pool scan. Referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; a code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one. Created 2026-09-08, escalation #1598, researcher-approved (as part of the original section 3c candidate list).

T14 - Body Parts: a strong denoting a body part carrying recognized figurative/theological significance in biblical anthropology (hand=power/action, face=presence/favor/anger, eye=perception/favor, entrails/bowels=compassion, lip/mouth=speech, blood=life/guilt/covenant) -- referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis. A code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one (e.g. H0639G 'face: anger' is both M02 and T14; H3027H 'hand: power' is both M72 and T14) -- the body-part identity and its figurative characteristic sense are two different facts about the same code. Created 2026-09-08, escalation #1598, researcher-approved.
Hebrew calendar month names (1st-12th month, e.g. Ziv/Bul/Ethanim/Ziv/Chislev/Tebeth/Shebat/Adar/Nisan/Sivan) -- a genuinely distinct, non-party, non-place category with no existing T-code home.
